classification: Synthetic verification metadata; no service configuration, knowledge, credentials, or running instance was read or changed.

initial_report.phase_status: Superseded: ordinary sample phase dictionaries also included the later isolated selection calls. Do not use these phase values for the final before/after comparison.
initial_report.valid_fields: Ordinary retrieve/read-freeze totals, result hashes, operation counts, and separate cProfile samples remain valid.
initial_report.random_growing_component_limit: The random single-component case did not grow the direct-hit live neighborhood between the two sizes. It is not the growing-neighborhood positive control.

primary_reports.steady_history: An actual retrieval at 2.0 with a distinct seed event precedes a fresh measured event at 3.0.
primary_reports.curve_fields: Use ordinary phase_median_seconds_inclusive.query_edges and selection, not selection_only_median_seconds. The isolated selection diagnostic can be affected by collection after full artifact construction.
primary_reports.harness_versions: The before harness preceded stricter comparison metadata and the separate expression probe. Fixed-neighborhood data, ordinary retrieval timing, and freeze timing are unchanged by those harness additions. Each report retains its actual harness/source hash.
primary_reports.tracked_baseline_dependencies: Only tracked memory.py is replayed by --baseline-ref. run_records.py and scratch.py are current imported dependencies; the old full-audit validator path remains supported. Dependency hashes are recorded by the expression-before and after reports.

growing_star_topology.background: Four singleton records per mark, with no background co-occurrence edges.
growing_star_topology.extra_star_records: Each extra record contains the four direct-hit marks plus up to four local neighbors. There are 25 extra records at 1000 marks and 75 at 3000 marks.
growing_star_topology.local_neighbors: size//10: 100 neighbors at 1000 marks; 300 neighbors at 3000 marks.
growing_star_topology.method_field_scope: fixed_neighborhood_marks=120 applies only to the fixed-neighborhood scenario. facts_per_mark=4 describes background records; extra star records are additional.

byte_comparison.returned_records: Complete canonical returned records equal baseline bytes for each identical input/state.
byte_comparison.audit_projection: Old edge_statistics is filtered to direct-hit incident edges. Remove only the declared edge_statistics_scope field and the necessarily changed durable envelope digest; every other field, including all observation transitions and rejected-neighbor decisions, remains byte-identical.
byte_comparison.independent_validation: Every actual audit and frozen material receipt is independently checked; durable audit hashing is not bypassed by the comparison projection.
byte_comparison.full_envelope: The complete new audit envelope intentionally differs because its statistics list has a declared scope. No full-envelope byte-equality claim is made.

runtime_limit: Read-freeze time includes retrieve, CanonicalSnapshot, and freeze_retrieval, but excludes scratch disk writes. The 3000-mark post-change steady median remains 11.21736470000178 seconds, exceeding the unchanged 5-second local budget. Global observation transitions, full mark-frequency output, source-index rebuilding, and audit encoding/freezing remain; this evidence does not prove whole-chain graph independence or live service acceptance.
expression_probe: An AST wrapper times only the edge_statistics expression in an additional profile sample. Its output is byte-compared independently and its timing is excluded from ordinary medians.
